info.prompt: Close-up of a player's hand reaching through neon data tendrils to grasp a bio-luminescent die—the die itself is faceted like a carved gemstone with liquid cyan core, held within a mechanical gauntlet whose gold filigree exoskeleton merges into the player's flesh, veins visible beneath skin glowing with synchronized magenta pulses, while in the background the neural cathedral's arches recede into infinite blackness dotted with floating amber runes and live-updating terminal code.
